title: shinytone: A Citation Tone Research Hub
description:
An interactive Shiny application and R package for citation tone research across tone languages. shinytone integrates the full workflow in one place: pitch (f0) extraction from .wav files (wrassp or Praat), artefact and outlier inspection, f0 correction by ear with a logged edit trail, by-speaker semitone or z-score normalisation, contour visualisation and clustering, growth-curve and generalised additive mixed modelling, and Chao tone numeral summarisation. Every plot and model panel prints the R code that produced it, so analyses can be re-run outside the app.

Live app: chenzixu.shinyapps.io/shinytone. Documentation: chenchenzi.github.io/citationtone_hub.
